test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of money, when invested at 14.5% p.a. simple interest amounts to Rs. 13,464 after 6 years. What was the sum invested?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest (R) = 14.5% per annum 

Time period (T) = 6 years 

Amount (A) = Rs. 13464

**Formula used:**

A = P (1 + RT/100)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 13464 = P (1 + 14.5 × 6/100)

⇒ 13464 = P (1 + 0.145 × 6)

⇒ 13464 = P (1.87)

⇒ 13464/1.87 = P 

⇒ P = Rs. 7200

**∴ The sum invested was Rs. 7200.**
